issues.desc: All three checklist items lack the userSees field. CLAUDE.md says userSees should contain precise user-observable output text (not abstract descriptions). The items are otherwise clear about their completion criteria, but adding userSees (e.g. CHK-001: script exits 0 with all assertions green; CHK-002: coverage comparison table printed; CHK-003: gate output listing unwired scripts) would make acceptance unambiguous.
